inspected_anchors.finding: Original identity and scope: generated mechanical-simulation scripts, often requiring expert improvement.
Version changes, continued pretraining, in-context learning, SFT/PEFT and reported expert/model-assisted dataset curation.
Similarity, execution and LLM-judge metrics are distinct; judge correlations are attributed to a companion study.
Tables6-8 have metric-dependent gains/losses; fine-tuning cost example excludes prior data preparation.
Authors acknowledge in-distribution case studies; API, world/axis/units errors distinguished.
Vehicle generation and iterative modification are source-reported demonstrations, not local reproduction.
Brittleness and domain-data limits; unlearning/tool/multi-agent extensions remain future work; artifact availability language differs across sections.
